target.nameStatus: operator must approve a globally available 3-24-character lowercase alphanumeric account name; none is assumed to exist

resources.reason: New dedicated disposable scope, only if still absent at separately approved creation time.
One empty non-HNS account using Azure's built-in public service endpoint; no application, containers, blobs, disks or compute.

design.networkRationale: The Azure Storage public endpoint needs no customer public-IP resource or VM. Default network ACL Allow deliberately permits public network reachability; it does not permit anonymous blob authorization.

storageControls.additionalHardening: Shared-key authorization is also proposed disabled; it is not a new verified promise or a reason to create identity/RBAC infrastructure.

requiredProofAfterApproval.requiredEvidence: Successful actual scoped deployment/operation and resource IDs, approved artifact hash, creation time, fresh ownership manifest and account-only empty sandbox. No fabricated baseline.
Fresh management-plane storage account read with actual resource ID/time and supportsHttpsTrafficOnly=true.
Same fresh scoped account observation shows allowBlobPublicAccess=false; missing/null properties are unknown, not a pass.
Observe publicNetworkAccess=Enabled and minimumTlsVersion=TLS1_2; preserve other approved guards.
New actual property observation after restoring supportsHttpsTrafficOnly=true; allowBlobPublicAccess must remain false before, during and after the seed.

verifier.coverage: Configuration evidence only. No proof of private connectivity, credential security, exploitation resistance, every HTTP client behavior or all anonymous-access attack scenarios.
verifier.evidenceCapture: Timestamp, exact scoped command, exit/error, actual account/deployment IDs, relevant observed properties and redacted evidence hashes. Do not retrieve keys or print tokens.
verifier.failureRule: Failed/missing/stale reads remain unknown; explicit HTTPS or anonymous-access property mismatch is a configuration finding, not proof of successful data exfiltration.

requiredOperatorPermissions: Create the one named RG in the selected subscription, or ask its authorized owner; no blanket Owner role requested.
Create/read/update/delete only the new StorageV2 account and its scoped deployment records in that RG.
Read actual account properties and, if needed to establish emptiness, only that account's management-plane container inventory; no listKeys, data writes or RBAC assignments.
Separately approved seed/rollback requires storage account write on the one actual empty account.
Check Microsoft.Storage availability/registration and applicable policy read-only before deployment; provider registration is not authorized.

preconditions: Separate explicit post-baseline operator seed consent, with a present operator and working same-property rollback path.
Actual legitimate deployment, fresh complete baseline property evidence, account-only empty inventory, no real data or application traffic.
Capture exact account ID, desired artifact hash, protected fields/ETag where available, timestamps and ownership; re-read before each write and stop on unexpected changes.
unchangedGuards: empty account with no containers, blobs or client traffic
seedAndRollback.observation: Read the actual account properties to detect supportsHttpsTrafficOnly=false and record the time/latency. Do not send HTTP data requests or credentials and never enable anonymous blob access.
seedAndRollback.rollback: Restore only supportsHttpsTrafficOnly=true on that same actual account in the operator's guarded finally path. Compare scope/protected fields before writing and escalate concurrent-change conflicts instead of overwriting unrelated state.
seedAndRollback.rollbackOnFailure: Immediately restore true on error, observation timeout or lost automation using the present operator fallback. No seed without this fallback; 120 seconds is a requested bound, not an unattended guarantee.
seedAndRollback.postRollback: Observe fresh actual supportsHttpsTrafficOnly=true, allowBlobPublicAccess=false, publicNetworkAccess=Enabled and minimumTlsVersion=TLS1_2. Missing fresh proof remains unknown.

plan: Restore HTTPS-only first and export nonsecret actual property/rollback evidence.
Confirm the actual created account is still owned and empty, then delete only that account.
Delete the named RG only when a fresh inventory proves it contains no unowned resources. Stop and ask the operator if resources/data were added unexpectedly.
Confirm actual account/RG deletion and check later for residual charges; no automated cleanup is claimed.

selectedMeters.meterName: LRS List and Create Container Operations

pricing.formula: 0 GB-month * 0.0184 + 0/10000 * 0.004 + 0/10000 * 0.05 = USD 0.00 for these listed usage assumptions only.
exclusions: Zero listed usage is not a guaranteed free Azure bill: actual metered usage, metadata/transactions, mandatory security/monitoring policies and residual charges are unmeasured.
Taxes, negotiated discounts, currency conversion, support and unplanned usage are excluded.
ARM property observations are not Blob data-plane read/list operations; no such operations, containers or stored blobs are planned.
No VM, disk, public-IP, Private Endpoint, DNS, NAT or VPN charge is included because none is proposed.
USD 1 is a proposed operator monitoring/stop threshold, not an enforced Azure budget cap.

evidence.referenceLimits: Public docs/prices support proposed configuration semantics and rates, not deployment or runtime proof.

approval.requestedNow: Confirm the proposed East US 2 public-endpoint-only empty account and authorize preparation/review of exact IaC only; no deployment yet.
approval.beforeProvisioning: Separately approve the final available account name, region, reviewed artifact hash, creation of only the named new RG and one account with these settings, USD 1 monitored threshold, two-hour lifetime and manifest-scoped cleanup.
approval.beforeSeed: After actual baseline proof, separately authorize supportsHttpsTrafficOnly true -> false -> true on that one empty account for at most the requested 120 seconds. Never enable anonymous blob access or send credentials over HTTP.
approval.safeNextAction: Present this minimal proposal; stop before IaC generation, provisioning, role assignment or drift.
